ahmedabad.name: IIM Ahmedabad
notes: 'Return on investment' uses the fee of the batch that graduated that year, so salary and fee match. It exists only for 2021, 2025 and 2026 because no fee source was found for the 2020-22 to 2022-24 batches.
Salary is MEP (maximum earning potential), IIMA's headline basis. Cash-only TGCC is shown where found. 2021 covers domestic offers only.
Placement figures are from IIMA's IPRS audited reports. The 2025 and 2026 offers/firms counts differ from the Annual Report 2024-25 text; the IPRS report is used here.
Faculty, PhD and student rows come from IIMA's NIRF filings, one per edition. They show the filing as submitted, not an independent count.
Research output was only readable for 2024-25. Earlier IIMA annual reports could not be opened, so the per-faculty research rows have one data point.
International faculty share was not found for any year.
dataFlags: Salary uses NIRF medians so it is comparable with the other IIMs. IPRS 'maximum earning potential' (₹34.59 L in 2025, ₹37 L in 2026) is higher and is not used.
2021 and 2022 medians (27.6, 30.0) come from the workbook's NIRF note; 2023-2025 (31.0, 31.0, 33.0) were re-read from the NIRF 2026 filing.

calcutta.name: IIM Calcutta
calcutta.salaryBasis: CTC as reported by the institute
notes: Salary: IIMC does not state whether its median is CTC. IIM A's figures are maximum earning potential (MEP), so the two are not directly comparable.
2021-2023 medians are what IIMC filed with NIRF. 2024 is missing. 2025 and 2026 come from news sites; check IIMC's own placement report.
Return on investment exists only for 2025 because only the 2023-25 fee was found.
Research output and faculty PhD share were not found for any year, so metrics 3 and 4 are mostly 'n/a'. Faculty PhD share could come from IIMC's faculty profile pages; research from Scopus.
International students show 0 in every year; the column positions in the NIRF tables were inferred.
Women faculty and international faculty were not found.
dataFlags: Medians 2021-2025 (27.67, 31.0, 33.67, 30.0, 35.0) match IIM Calcutta's NIRF filings. The workbook had 2024 blank and 2025 as 34.0; NIRF gives 30.0 and 35.0.
News sites attribute ₹33.67 L to both 2023 and 2024; the NIRF filing assigns it to the 2022-23 batch (graduating 2023).
PhD share is from the NIRF 2025 (105 of 105 listed faculty) and 2026 (91 of 92) filings.
